statement: Is it true that sum_{n=1}^infty (-1)^n n/p_n converges (p_n = nth prime)? UnsolvedMath EP-15 marks it Open.
target: Decide convergence of S = sum (-1)^n n/p_n; this investigation delivers reductions, obstruction isolation, and conditional/numerical status only.
assumptions: Quantitative Hardy-Littlewood prime tuples conjecture, Conjecture 1.3 of Tao arXiv:2308.07205 (k <= (log log x)^5, tuples in [0, log^2 x], error C x^{1-eps}) for the conditional convergence result
Unconditional inputs used: PNT; Zhang/Maynard/Polymath bounded gaps (liminf g_n <= 246); Westzynthius large gaps; GPY positive-proportion small gaps (Publ. Math. Debrecen 79 (2011), Thm 1)
direct_answer: Not known unconditionally; the problem remains open. Proven convergent assuming strong uniform HL prime-tuples (Tao 2023). All classical alternating-series criteria are provably inapplicable (R1, R2); convergence is exactly equivalent to convergence of the parity-resolved pair series sum_k b_k = sum_k (p_{2k-1} - (2k-1) g_{2k-1})/(p_{2k-1} p_{2k}) (R4), and no unconditional theorem can decide it (counterexample world W(theta,rho), R5).
proof_status: No unconditional proof or disproof. Conditional proof under HL-strong: Ta23 Thm 1.4. Reductions R1-R5 proved in ANALYSIS.md.
counterexample_status: No counterexample to convergence exists (numerics and heuristics favor convergence); a model world W(theta != 1, rho) with divergent pair series is constructed that satisfies all published unconditional prime statistics, showing current technology cannot decide the problem.
unconditional_results: R1: {n/p_n} not eventually monotone in either direction (up-steps i.o. via Maynard/Polymath246 + p_n/n ~ ln n -> infinity; down-steps i.o. via Westzynthius)

R2: total variation TV(N) >> ln ln N unconditionally via exact step identity a_{n+1}-a_n = (p_n - n g_n)/(p_n p_{n+1}) on the GPY positive-density set {g_n <= (1/4) ln p_n}; Dirichlet-BV criterion provably inapplicable

R3: exact reduction to delta_n = -n(p_n-E(n))/(p_n E(n)) with E = Cipolla truncation; |delta_n| << e^{-c sqrt(ln n)} unconditionally, O(n^{-1/2+o(1)}) under RH [CONDITIONAL]; envelope decay alone insufficient (explicit countersequence)

R4: exact identity S_{2K} = sum_{k<=K} b_k, b_k = (p_{2k-1}-(2k-1)g_{2k-1})/(p_{2k-1}p_{2k}), b_k>0 <=> g_{2k-1} < p_{2k-1}/(2k-1); verified exactly for all k<=50000 against independent sieve; b_1=1/6 matches max|B_K|=1/6 at K=1

R5: counterexample world W(theta,rho): bulk odd gaps theta*Lambda_k, even gaps (2-theta)*Lambda_k with Lambda_k = ln(2k) + lnln(2k), so bulk pair totals 2Lambda_k telescope (Stirling + integral of ln ln via x lnln x - li(x)) to p~_N = N(ln N + ln ln N - 1) + O(N/ln N): FULL Cipolla main terms through the constant -1, honest residual o(N); parity bias theta forces drift ~(1-theta)/2 * ln ln K (divergent; systematic non-parity pieces form convergent series sum O(1/(k ln^2 k))); compensated sprinkle of bounded gaps contributes an absolutely convergent series O(sum 1/(k^{3/2} ln k)); all published unconditional theorems satisfiable in W
D.1: sibling series sum (-1)^n / g_n diverges unconditionally (terms >= 1/246 infinitely often by Maynard/Polymath; numerically #{g_n=2, n<=1e7} = 738597)

D.2: U_c = sum 1/(n g_n (lnln n)^c) converges for c > 2 (dyadic sieve-class argument reproduced in-file) and diverges for c <= 1 (GPY-based, proved in-file); V_2 diverges under Conj 1.3 (Ta23/Ford); V_c open for 0<=c<2 even under Conj 1.3
missing_bridge: Uniform-in-lambda parity-resolved asymptotics for #{k <= K : g_{2k-1} <= lambda p_{2k-1}/(2k-1)} (equivalently parity-equidistribution of pi(m) in log-length intervals, i.e. a power-saving bound for sum_{n<=x} (-1)^{pi(n)}, e.g. Ta23's << x/(log log x)^{1.1}) => signed pair series sum_k b_k converges => EP-15 convergent. Supplied today only by Quantitative HL prime-tuples via Tao's random-sifted-model proof; nothing weaker is known, and by R5 nothing compatible with W(theta!=1, rho) can suffice.
scope: Analysis + reduction + obstruction isolation + numerical integration. No claim is made that EP-15 is solved or disproved.

key_values.max_BK: 1/6 exactly, attained at K=1 (transient first pair 2/3-1/2)
key_values.tao_limit_estimate: -0.052161 (reported in Ta23); consistent with slow O((log log x)^{-0.1}) conditional rate

obstruction: The series sum (-1)^n n/p_n sits exactly in the dead zone of alternating-series theory: its terms n/p_n decay only like 1/ln n, far too slowly for absolute convergence; the bounded-gaps theorems of Zhang-Maynard force a_{n+1}>a_n infinitely often (indeed a_{n+1}<a_n iff n g_n > p_n, and g_n <= 246 << p_n/n i.o.), so Leibniz monotonicity is provably false in both directions; the exact step identity a_{n+1}-a_n = (p_n - n g_n)/(p_n p_{n+1}), evaluated on the GPY positive-density set of gaps <= eta ln p_n, gives total variation >> sum 1/(n ln n) ~ ln ln N -> infinity (observed TV(N) ~= 0.55 ln ln N), killing Dirichlet-BV; and after subtracting the smooth Cipolla model f(n)=n/E(n) — whose alternating sum converges — the residual sum (-1)^n delta_n, delta_n = -n(p_n-E(n))/(p_n E(n)), has envelope |delta_n| << e^{-c sqrt(ln n)} (RH would merely sharpen it to n^{-1/2+o(1)}, which by itself decides nothing: (-1)^n n^{-1/2}/ln n meets that envelope with divergent alternating sum). All unconditional error-term technology is parity-blind and monotonicity-free: it bounds |p_n - E(n)| but says nothing about the odd/even correlation driving the exact pair terms b_k = (p_{2k-1} - (2k-1) g_{2k-1})/(p_{2k-1} p_{2k}), on which convergence is exactly pinned by S_{2K} = sum b_k. The counterexample world W(theta,rho) — parity-biased bulk gaps whose pair-means 2*Lambda_k (Lambda_k = ln(2k)+lnln(2k)) telescope to p~_N = N(ln N + ln ln N - 1) + O(N/ln N), i.e. the full Cipolla main terms plus o(N), compensated bounded-gap sprinkle, sparse huge gaps — satisfies every published unconditional prime statistic while its pair series diverges like (1-theta)/2 ln ln K (the systematic non-parity pieces of b~_k form convergent series sum O(1/(k ln^2 k))); hence resolution demands genuinely new parity-resolved local prime statistics. Exact missing bridge quoted in missing_implication; supplied today only by Quantitative HL prime-tuples via Tao 2023; nothing weaker is known, and nothing weaker can suffice by R5.
missing_implication: uniform parity-resolved asymptotic for #{k<=K : g_{2k-1} <= lambda p_{2k-1}/(2k-1)} across lambda (equiv. equidistribution of parity of pi(m) in log-length intervals / power-saving bound for sum_{n<=x} (-1)^{pi(n)}) => convergence of sum_k b_k => convergence of sum (-1)^n n/p_n; Tao 2023 gives this modulo Conjecture 1.3 (strong uniform HL prime tuples)

counterexample_analysis.model: W(theta,rho): bulk odd gaps g~_{2k-1}=theta Lambda_k(1+xi), even gaps (2-theta)Lambda_k(1+xi'), Lambda_k = L_k + ell_k = ln(2k) + lnln(2k), plus density-rho sprinkling of gaps <=246 on odd positions with same-parity mass redistribution within k^{1/2}-windows and pulse compensation on even gaps
counterexample_analysis.theta_drift_formula: (1-theta)*sum_{k<=K} 1/(2k L_k) ~ ((1-theta)/2) ln ln K  [CORRECTED from page's (theta-1)*sum 1/(2k L_k^2); see erratum]

executed_page_values_L2_sum_K_1e6.note: L^2-sum has CONVERGENT total; does not itself exhibit ln ln divergence

corrected_drift_first_power_K_1e6.note: sign corrected: sub-average odd gaps push S_{2K} upward; partial sums genuinely diverge like ((1-theta)/2) ln ln K

counterexample_analysis.sprinkle_cost: absolutely convergent: per-event mismatch <= O(1/(k^{3/2} ln k)) via same-parity redistribution; pulse baseline effects <= O(sum 1/(k^2 ln k))
counterexample_analysis.psi_reason: per-pair gap totals telescope to exactly 2 Lambda_k in bulk and pulses redistribute locally, so p~_{2K} = 2 + 2 sum_{k<=K} Lambda_k + O(rho K^{1/2} ln K); Euler-Maclaurin: sum ln(2k) = K ln(2K) - K + O(ln K) (Stirling) and sum lnln(2k) = K lnln(2K) - li(2K)/2 + O(lnln K) with li(2K)/2 = K/ln(2K)(1+o(1)), giving p~_N = N(ln N + ln ln N - 1) + O(N/ln N) = full Cipolla main terms through the constant -1 plus o(N); theta-dependence cancels exactly in even-indexed cumulatives (theta*Sigma + (2-theta)*Sigma = 2*Sigma), and the corrected pair drift b~_k = ((1-theta)Lambda_k)/(2k Lambda_k^2) + O(1/(k Lambda_k^2)) is untouched to leading order since the systematic pieces form convergent series sum O(1/(k ln^2 k)); hence pi~/psi~ match PNT-scale statistics up to local perturbations while the pair series diverges

sibling_series.diverges_and_why: sum (-1)^n/g_n diverges UNCONDITIONALLY: Maynard/Polymath give g_n <= 246 infinitely often, so |term| >= 1/246 along an infinite sequence => terms do not tend to zero; numerically #{n<=1e7 : g_n=2} = 738597; also recorded in Ta23 Sec 5
sibling_series.weighted_absolute_c_gt_2_and_why: U_c = sum 1/(n g_n (lnln n)^c) < infinity for c > 2: dyadic sieve-class count #{g in [eps ln n, 2 eps ln n)} << eps Y per block makes each class contribute O(1/(ln Y (lnln Y)^c)), J ~ log ln Y classes fold into (lnln Y)^{1-c}, and sum_m (ln m)^{1-c}/m converges iff c > 2 (Erdos-Nathanson per page; Sawhney Selberg-sieve proof per page [UNVERIFIED-citation]); U_c diverges for c <= 1 by GPY positive-density small gaps (proved in ANALYSIS.md D.2b); V_c converges absolutely for c>2, V_2 diverges under Conj 1.3 (Ta23/Ford), V_c open for 0<=c<2 even under Conj 1.3
